sections.heading: MIT Pune vs Institute of Science Poonas College of Computer Science for Mass Communication (PG): which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose MIT Pune if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹5 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹2.72 lakh, in a private Mass Communication (PG) setting at Pune.

Choose Institute of Science Poonas College of Computer Science if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹4 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹30,000, in a private Mass Communication (PG) setting at Pune.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹2.72 lakh as a programme total for Master of Arts in Mass Communication at MIT Pune.

Our records show ₹30,000 as a tuition figure for Master of Journalism and Mass Communication at Institute of Science Poonas College of Computer Science. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: MIT Pune's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹10 LPA on Master of Arts in Mass Communication. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

Institute of Science Poonas College of Computer Science's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹8 LPA on Master of Journalism and Mass Communication. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, MIT Pune or Institute of Science Poonas College of Computer Science?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. MIT Pune and Institute of Science Poonas College of Computer Science differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of Mass Communication (PG) classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for MIT Pune vs Institute of Science Poonas College of Computer Science?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹2.72 lakh for MIT Pune on Master of Arts in Mass Communication; our records list ₹30,000 for Institute of Science Poonas College of Computer Science on Master of Journalism and Mass Communication. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for MIT Pune and Institute of Science Poonas College of Computer Science?
faqs.answer: MIT Pune's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹10 LPA on Master of Arts in Mass Communication. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do MIT Pune and Institute of Science Poonas College of Computer Science accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for MIT Pune, and no listed exam on this page for Institute of Science Poonas College of Computer Science. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Pune, Maharashtra. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
